outcome: Human milk oligosaccharide (HMO) levels in mother milk
finding: This study found that levels of human milk oligosaccharides (HMOs) in milk and infant feces vary by maternal Lewis/Secretor status and infant age, and that mode of delivery and early exposure to hospital environment can impact HMO metabolization.
mod_finding: Variation in HMO metabolization was associated with mode of delivery, where caesarean section or early exposure to hospital environment delayed the transition from nonspecific or structure-specific consumption stage to the complete consumption stage.
